message: With the stormy weather rolling in, I found myself reminiscing about simpler times—like cozying up with a stack of board games instead of scrolling through screens. The National Weather Service has a handy guide on flood safety that I think is worth a peek. It’s a useful reminder to prepare, but also a great excuse to gather the family for some good old-fashioned fun indoors. What’s your favorite rainy day activity? ☔️
